name: looksmaxxing.guide claim ledger
description: Atomic, evidence-tiered claims about male grooming and aesthetics, each verified against primary literature with a recorded verification date.
measurementTechnique: Europe PMC + openFDA retrieval, relevance gating, LLM entailment against full text

claims.canonical_text: Bone smashing increases facial bone density through Wolff's law.
claims.harm_note: Bone smashing risks fracture, nerve damage and permanent asymmetry. Wolff's law does not apply to blunt facial trauma.

Mechanotransduction and musculoskeletal regeneration: Molecular mechanisms and interdisciplinary applications.
Jewish Contributions to Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery.
Advances of piezoelectric biomaterials in bone defect repair: The role of direct and inverse piezoelectric effect.

claims.canonical_text: Micro-implant-assisted rapid palatal expansion (MARPE) produces measurable skeletal maxillary expansion in adults.
claims.harm_note: MARPE is a clinician-placed skeletal appliance. Reported complications include implant failure, asymmetric expansion, pain and gingival trauma; it requires CBCT assessment and orthodontic supervision.

sources.title: The effect of different micro-implant-assisted rapid palatal expanders designed digitally: a three-dimensional finite element analysis.
CBCT-based evidence on alternate expansion-constriction (AEC) protocols with micro-implant assisted/skeletal expanders (MARPE/MSE): a scoping review.
Relationship between the efficacy of micro-implant-assisted rapid maxillary arch expansion and maturation of the midpalatal sutures.
sources.note: Reports MARPE efficacy relative to suture maturation stage in adults; supports skeletal (not merely dental) expansion.

sources.title: Clinical Outcomes, Success/Failure Patterns, and Complications of Microscrew-Assisted Rapid Palatal Expansion in Post-Pubertal Transverse Maxillary Deficiency: A Scoping Review.
sources.note: Systematic review of MARPE outcomes reports skeletal expansion achieved in adult patients with defined success/failure patterns and complications.

claims.canonical_text: Orthognathic surgery produces measurable change in facial skeletal proportions.
claims.harm_note: Irreversible surgical intervention. Outcomes vary; requires board-certified surgeon consultation and realistic expectation setting.

claims.canonical_text: Mewing (habitual tongue posture) remodels adult skeletal jaw and maxilla structure.
claims.harm_note: Craniofacial sutures fuse in adulthood; soft-tissue and postural change is not skeletal remodelling. Claims of adult bone change are unsupported.

claims.harm_note: Craniofacial sutures fuse in adulthood; soft-tissue and postural change is not skeletal remodelling. Claims of adult bone change are unsupported.

claims.canonical_text: The midpalatal suture progressively ossifies with age and is typically well advanced toward fusion in adults.

sources.title: Evaluation of midpalatal suture maturation in young adults using cone-beam computed tomography.
sources.note: CBCT staging shows midpalatal suture maturation stages C-E predominate in young adults; directly supports progressive ossification with age.
